android.desc:
This app is 100% open source!  You can find the source code here:
https://github.com/1nikolas/play-integrity-checker-app

This app shows info about your device integrity as reported by Google Play Services. If any of this fails could mean your device is rooted or tampered in a way (for example having an unlocked bootloader).

quotes.text:
Weird, you should pass the basic and fail the remaining two:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=gr.nikolasspyr.integritycheck

(FWIW, sometimes when you _block_ the app from the Play Integrity API (in this pop-up) the app that wants to perform the check works, while it fails when you do not block it)
quotes.story_title: Around a dozen banking apps began specifically permitting GrapheneOS
